# Lightfast Digital (Pty) Ltd

A registered South African software company. It builds POPIAdesk and VetGuard.
Every company fact below is a public record.

## Company record

- Enterprise number: 2026/652553/07, issued by the CIPC (South Africa's companies
  registrar). Searchable on the CIPC company register at cipc.co.za.
- Legal name: Lightfast Digital (Pty) Ltd. A private company.
- Registered: 17 August 2026 (the effective date on the registration certificate).
- Based in: Cape Town, South Africa. The registered address is on the CIPC record.
- Company page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lightfastdigital/
- Contact: admin@lightfastdigital.com
- Founded by: Phillip-Juan van der Berg. Directors are listed on the CIPC record.

## What we build

- POPIAdesk. Status: built, opening soon. POPIA compliance software for South African
  small and medium businesses. In its own words, from popiadesk.co.za on 31 August 2026:
  "POPIAdesk generates your core POPIA documents, tracks a live compliance score, and
  manages data subject requests against their deadlines." The free readiness check is
  live at https://popiadesk.co.za/assess
- VetGuard. Status: free and open source, available now. A tool for developers that
  checks the code libraries a project installs for fakes and tampering. In its own words,
  from its published description, version 0.3.0: "No account, no server, no telemetry."
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/vetguard

## This page and your data

Cookies: none. Trackers: none. Requests to other servers: none. Files: 1. Size: 122 KB, uncompressed.
These are measured on every build and the page states only what was measured.
